text: 59 1. Listen and recite. 2. Read and write. 3. Write the word that rhymes with the following. 4. Write two to three sentences on ‘My Pet’. My kitty cat is black and white, She sleeps all day and plays all night. At dawn she knows when to be fed, And walks atop my sleepy head. Once she finally gets her food, She soon adopts a happy mood. Then in the chair she likes the best, She stretches out to take a rest. - Ryan Gibbs white ____________ fed ____________ food ____________ best ____________ kitty fed black food sleepy finally white mood adopts chair night dawn sleeps stretches My Kitty Cat 3.11
